property_summary: In the reference C, any call to fallback with exactly 10 ether succeeds (no state or timing condition can make it revert), while in the mutant the assignment of pastBlockTime=timestamp+1 before the guard forces block.timestamp > pastBlockTime to be false, so every such call reverts.
change_summary: Move the pastBlockTime assignment above the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) guard so the guard always fails and calls revert.
